newsitem.title: USA: Litton unit wins $250 million defense pacts.
newsitem.headline: Litton unit wins $250 million defense pacts.

text.p: Litton Industries Inc. said Wednesday its information technology unit PRC had won $250 million worth of purchase agreements from the U.S. Naval Information Systems Management Centre.
The agreements call for PRC to provide information technology support services for the Navy, Marine Corps, Coast Guard and other Defence Department operations, Litton said in a statement.
The award covers a three-year base period with two one-year options, and allows PRC to provide a broad range of technical services, Litton said.
Litton's stock rose 44 cents to $50.75 on the New York Stock Exchange at midafternoon.
